## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the boundary it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] Python tests pass.
- [ ] Relevant Rust/container tests pass when affected.
- [ ] Version, changelog, source pins and notices are updated when required.
- [ ] No authentication material, signed media URL, token, private address or unreviewed log is included.
- [ ] Implemented, automated-tested and physically tested claims are clearly distinguished.
